segments.report_label: FINAL: Required by all Candidates who participated in the General Election. Due by 5:00 p.m. on December 2nd, 2021 — separator sheet 'Chad Lamb / 12/2/2021'; form FINAL (Dec 2nd) box checked; signature date 11/30/21; received-stamp NOV 30 2021 11:59 by Tangee

INTERIM: Required for all candidates who were successful in the Primary Election or who are otherwise proceeding to the municipal general election. Due by 5:00 p.m. on October 26, 2021 — separator sheet 'Chad Lamb / 10/26/2021'; form INTERIM (Oct 26) box checked; signature date 10/26/21; received-stamp OCT 26 2021 12:30 pm by Tangee(?)

notes: Bundle order is FINAL first, then INTERIM. Segment 1 (FINAL, pp1-6): p1 typed separator sheet; p2 cover form (form 'Page 1') with all six lines printed; p3-p4 boilerplate code provisions (form 'Page 2'/'Page 3', candidate 'Lamb, Chad, R', date of report 11/30/21); p5 Attachment A/A-1 — handwritten '0' in both box 1 ($50-or-less) and box 2 (over $50), A-1 itemization table entirely blank, handwritten TOTAL that reads as '0' (a circled zero/oval before the '-'); p6 Attachment B with the 3 itemized expenditures above, printed TOTAL $379.27. No contributions itemized in the FINAL report — that is the source, not an omission. Segment 2 (INTERIM, pp7-10): p7 typed separator sheet; p8 cover form with all six lines printed; p9-p10 boilerplate code provisions; on p10 the 'Date of Report' field shows a struck-through auto-populated value (appears '1/0/00', partially obscured by the strike) with handwritten '10/26/21' beside it. RANGE ENDS MID-REPORT: the INTERIM report's Attachment A (itemizing the $5,577.00 in over-$50 contributions) and Attachment B (itemizing the $5,407.08 expenditures) fall on p11+ (other agent's range). Uncertain glyphs: p2 received-stamp time read as '11:59' and clerk name 'Tangee' (handwritten, cursive); p8 stamp time read as '12:30 pm' and annotation after it possibly 'Tangee-something' (illegible cursive); p5 handwritten zeros could arguably be '-0-' marks. Candidate address on both covers is redacted (blacked out) in the source. Parenthesized line-5 values transcribed verbatim including parentheses.
